regionalFailover.strategy: Manual with runbook — can be automated via K8s

dataReplication.postgresql: Streaming replication to read replica(s). WAL archiving for PITR.
dataReplication.redis: Redis Cluster or Sentinel for cross-region. Currently: standalone.
dataReplication.queue: AOF persistence survives restart. Cross-region: Kafka or RabbitMQ mirroring.
dataReplication.recommendation: Deploy read replicas in us-west-2 with streaming replication

geoRouting.recommendedApproach: Route53 latency-based routing -> K8s ingress -> regional gateway

disasterRegionRecovery.fullRegionFailure: Restore from pg_dump backup + Redis AOF. Estimated 30min RTO.
disasterRegionRecovery.procedure: launch K8s in secondary region -> restore DB -> start services -> update DNS
disasterRegionRecovery.backupLocation: pilot/outputs/ (local disk — needs S3/cloud storage for production)

immediateActions: Containerize all services via existing Dockerfiles
